title: Watergate Salad
description: Pistachio pudding fluff with pineapple, marshmallows, pecans and maraschino cherries, chilled overnight.

ingredients.name: maraschino cherries
ingredients.note: for the top, patted very dry

steps.title: Mix base
steps.text: In a large bowl, stir {pudding} into {pineapple} with its juice. Do not drain the pineapple; the juice is what activates the pudding. Stir 2 minutes.

steps.title: Fold in Cool Whip
steps.text: Gently fold in {coolwhip} until no streaks remain.

steps.title: Chill overnight
steps.text: Cover and refrigerate overnight. The marshmallows soften and the flavors meld.

steps.title: Garnish
steps.text: Before serving, top with {cherrytop} patted dry so the red does not bleed into the green.

notes: Quantities are starting points (the saved version had no amounts). Green and red together is essential for presentation. Make the night before; chilling overnight is required, not optional.
